source: The Solar System master prompt (docs/SOLAR-SYSTEM.md): Part 2 section A4 (every metric by tier) and Part 4 section C3 (every ratio). Transcribed a row a recipe.
confidenceNote: Formulas are declared here in words and computed by the function named in fn (engines/solar.js, step 2 of the build). No figure is stored here; a recipe is a rule for making one.
note: facets are the nine shares Part 4 lists without NEW, each a view inside a Part 2 metric (parent), not counted in the 184. tier N needs only levels in bands 1 to N (lint). needs are the levels that must hold a value (a number, a none or a rough) before the metric can compute; while any is missing the metric is locked and names them. derived: true means the person was never asked for this; it falls out of facts collected for other reasons. sharpenedBy are later levels that tighten the band. earnedWhen names the situation that turns a metric into an earned badge instead of a number (debt.none: "Debt free"), never an N/A. ratio carries the two sides and the benchmark key into data/benchmarks.json. core marks the rates pinned at the top of the shelf (1.14). unit: cents, rate, months, years, date, flag, score, list, text, multiple, dollarsPerYear.
